credits_text: Starring KAT LENZ, WAYNE CRAWFORD, MARTIN LANDAU, COLLEEN CAMP, ALLEN GOORWITZ, CHARLIE MARTIN SMITH, LORRAINE CRAWFORD, G. ANDREW LANE. Produced by WAYNE CRAWFORD & ANDREW LANE. Written by WAYNE CRAWFORD, CRAWFORD LANE, BARBARA ELAINE SMITH. Directed by KILDY BROOKS. Music by ROBERT O. RAGLAND.
description: A dark, imposing mansion is illuminated against a stormy night sky, with dramatic lighting casting long shadows, suggesting suspense and mystery.
